environment: RunPod CPU Pods with immutable images and pod-local disks
protocol: HTTP/1.1 over direct RunPod TCP origin; no HTTP intermediary

runpod.topology: three isolated target Pods, one MariaDB Pod, one load-generator Pod

upstream.runtime: replace with immutable image digest and runtime version
upstream.runtimeIdentity: replace with frozen RunPod API and SSH runtime identity
upstream.runpodPodId: replace with frozen RunPod Pod ID

upstream-php.runtime: replace with immutable nginx/PHP-FPM image identities
upstream-php.configuration: replace with immutable nginx/PHP/TLS configuration digests
upstream-php.runtimeIdentity: replace with frozen RunPod API and SSH runtime identity
upstream-php.runpodPodId: replace with frozen RunPod Pod ID

new-java.runtime: replace with immutable image digest and runtime version
new-java.runtimeIdentity: replace with frozen RunPod API and SSH runtime identity
new-java.runpodPodId: replace with frozen RunPod Pod ID

loadGenerator.runtime: replace with immutable load-generator image digest and k6 version

hardware.podId: replace with frozen RunPod Pod ID
hardware.podType: replace with exact RunPod CPU Pod type
